facts.fact: IMIJ states SNIAC has issued about 1,291,910 digital certificates for authentication and qualified digital signature.

IMIJ states SNIAC supplies identification and authentication (e-ID) data and services to dozens of public and private bodies, including banks and insurers, through more than 134 configured services/APIs and over 30 million requests.

CPV.note: The document says nothing on links between the civil register and the ID system.
It counts cards issued (about 631,720) but gives no share of the population enrolled.
Nothing on a number given at birth.
It says SNIAC is under IMIJ management but not who operates, maintains or owns the platform.
It names no public register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: IMIJ states SNIAC has contributed to issuing about 631,720 national identity cards (CNI), 513,862 electronic passports and 14,235 residence permits since its implementation.
